text.en: Simmim is row 2 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: Simmim 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 2 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates Simmim with “Simmim: A simple framework for masked image modeling”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Simmim 与论文《Simmim: A simple framework for masked image modeling》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Zhenda Xie, Zheng Zhang, Yue Cao, Han Hu”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 谢振达、张拯、曹越、胡瀚；官方英文原文为“Zhenda Xie, Zheng Zhang, Yue Cao, Han Hu”。

text.en: Zhenda Xie, Zheng Zhang, Yue Cao and Han Hu are listed by BenchCouncil in the same order as the paper's equal-contribution group; the CVF and Microsoft Research records contain all four names.
text.zh: BenchCouncil 依次列出的谢振达、张拯、曹越和胡瀚对应论文的共同贡献作者组；CVF 与微软研究院记录均包含四人。

text.en: SimMIM uses random masking with moderately large patches, direct regression of raw RGB pixel values and a lightweight linear prediction head, without requiring a discrete tokenizer or clustering target.
text.zh: SimMIM 采用中等偏大的随机遮挡块、原始 RGB 像素值直接回归和轻量线性预测头，不需要离散分词器或聚类目标。

text.en: The paper reports 83.8% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy with ViT-B, 87.1% with the roughly 650-million-parameter SwinV2-H, and a 3-billion-parameter SwinV2-G trained with far less labeled data than the cited prior practice.
text.zh: 论文报告 ViT-B 在 ImageNet-1K 上达到 83.8% top-1，约 6.5 亿参数的 SwinV2-H 达到 87.1%，并以明显更少的标注数据训练 30 亿参数 SwinV2-G。
